title_en: Hotel for sale in the center of Tirana
description_en: Hotel for sale in the center of Tirana. The hotel is 2-storey + veranda, it is organized in 7 rooms of different typologies, it was recently invested with taste, it has a swimming pool and a regular mortgage document where 325 m² is land and 320 m² of building divided into 2 floors of 160 m² each. The terrace has solar panels, there is also a small bar with a kitchen area as well as courtyard with the possibility of parking. The property is revalued and the owner also allows the purchase with credit. For more information and for a visit to the property, contact us
